questions.question: Does the1680 Lindsaylands testament or another kin record identify Robert’s father and distinguish the older weaver from a younger intermediary?

web_searches.query: Held Carnwath/Libberton family accounts, supplied OPR birth index through1700, Lindsaylands1680 case and bounded local QMD search Lindsaylands1680
web_searches.result: The maintained1680 case records an archival index entry and no linked original reading. The 1713 marriage and1722 baptism name no paternal ancestry for Robert. Known Robert baptisms, including the1655 Edinburgh weaver’s son and1665 StCuthbert’s child, supply comparisons without a recorded bridge to the Wilson adult. The1720 mother correction does support a separate new Wilson maternal connection, not Robert’s own father. Scotland’s People was signed out; specific-original access remains pending.
web_searches.scope: Held-record comparison and observed sign-in state only; not an exhaustive variant, full-register or source-file absence search.
